name: SHAGHIL Product Design System — Foundation Tokens

referencesLockedSystems.color: brand-final/color/final/shaghil-color-tokens.json (Graphite Pulse — do not duplicate hex values, reference by token name)
referencesLockedSystems.typography: brand-final/typography/final/shaghil-typography-tokens.json (IBM Plex Sans Arabic + IBM Plex Sans)

spacing.rationale: Validated against the real audited product (SHAGHIL_UI_AUDIT.md): existing padding/margin/gap values (5,7,8,9,10,12,13,14,16,18,20,22px) already loosely gesture toward a 4/8 rhythm without being disciplined about it - this scale formalizes that intent rather than importing an arbitrary one.

unnamedUtility.20px: occasional in-between card/grid gap where 16 is tight and 24 is loose
unnamedUtility.40px: occasional in-between section spacing on tablet where 32 is tight and 48 is loose

layout.contentMaxWidthRationale: Matches the current product's own .wrap max-width - already proven to work for the 3-up engine grid and forms; kept rather than replaced.
layout.readingMeasureRationale: A distinct, narrower max-width reserved for AI-generated long-form output and other extended reading content, separate from the wider dashboard/grid shell width.
layout.shell: No persistent sidebar exists in the current product and none is introduced here - the shell is a top app bar plus a single stacked content column. This matches the product's real, current structure and the operational (not dashboard-heavy) nature of SHAGHIL's actual screens.

radius.rationale: Consolidates the audit's 7 uncoordinated values (8/12/13/14/16/20/22px) into 4 deliberate steps. Pill-shaped (radius-full) is reserved for status badges/avatars only, never general buttons or cards, per the explicit instruction to avoid excessive pill-shaped UI.

elevation.rationale: The current product uses zero box-shadow anywhere and carries all hierarchy through surface color and border - already aligned with the Founder's stated principle. This system formalizes that as a rule and adds only the minimum shadow needed for genuinely floating elements (menus, modals).
elevation.none: no shadow - the default for nearly all UI, hierarchy comes from graphite surface tokens

subtle.use: a popover/dropdown menu that must visually lift off a busy background

borders.rationale: References the locked Graphite Pulse tokens by name - no new hex values are introduced. The existing product's single 1px-solid-border convention (already consistent per the audit) is preserved as the default.
borders.subtle: graphite.border at reduced visual weight - used for the quietest internal dividers
borders.strong: graphite.borderStrong (1-2px) - selected/active card outline, emphasized dividers
borders.focus: signal.border / signal.primary (2px) - focus-visible ring on every interactive element

button.large: not defined in this phase - the product's operational screens are fully served by small/medium; a large CTA size would only be relevant to a future marketing site, out of scope here

componentDimensions.input: 40px height (aligns with medium button for side-by-side layouts)

interactionTiming.rationale: The current product has zero hover/pressed transitions anywhere (a real audit finding) - these are new, deliberately restrained values, not decorative motion.
interactionTiming.base: 200ms - panel reveal, focus ring appearance, card selection
interactionTiming.easing: cubic-bezier(0.2, 0, 0, 1) - a calm, precise 'productive' ease, not bouncy or playful
